correctness.rationale: Conditional on three independent gamma-clock increments and the pathwise-shared gamma diffusivity, the two disjoint increments are centered Gaussian; Isserlis yields exact two-window fourth moments. The Gaussian kernel is positive definite by its completely monotone representation, its zeroth/first integrals give an exact affine-plus-exponentially-small variance identity, and gamma Laplace transforms control the asymptotic uniformly in gap. Strict positivity and coupling give monotonicity; dominated convergence gives the inverse-square memory profile. The finite H=1 exact special case passed 846 reproduction checks; no finite experiment substitutes for the proof.

originality.rationale: The same-model arXiv primary article is inspected in its accessible full HTML: it reports one-time MSD, kurtosis, PDF and non-Gaussianity, not two-window squared-increment covariances. The novel assessed claim is strict finite-gap monotonicity, uniform inverse-length clock correction and inverse-square gap-kernel profile in the full three-component process. Published research records and related primary full texts were compared by exact object and implication; no stronger covering statement was found, subject to the stated generic-theorem residual risk.

value.rationale: The two-window squared-increment correlation is a physically motivated fourth-order single-particle tracking observable for the very active-cargo model of the source. Its exact strict gap decay and positive floor separate quenched environmental heterogeneity from short-memory Gaussian force correlations, while the universal 1/L coefficient isolates gamma-clock variability. The 1/L^2 gap profile gives the first trace of the parent correlation kernel after macroscopic diffusive scaling, uniformly across a continuum of parameters rather than arbitrary finite casework.
